name: benign prostatic hyperplasia overview
title: Benign prostatic hyperplasia decision chart: after a mandatory assessment and lifestyle changes, treatment is chosen by how bothersome the symptoms are and how large the prostate is (watchful waiting, alpha blocker, 5-alpha reductase inhibitor or both), with referral for transurethral resection when complicated or failing; plus how to recognise prostatitis instead

root.title: Lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) in an older man: how BOTHERSOME, how BIG, and is it COMPLICATED?
lines: every man: history (antihistamines, decongestants, diuretics, opioids, tricyclics, caffeine) · rectal exam: size, nodules, tenderness · urinalysis: not an infection?
International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS) grades and tracks it · prostate-specific antigen (PSA) if life expectancy ≥ 10 years and cancer would change management
first: LIFESTYLE · less fluid at night · treat sleep apnea · compression stockings · diuretic earlier in the day
PROSTATITIS instead? ACUTE: sudden dysuria · CHRONIC: recurrent urinary infections → four-glass test · CHRONIC PELVIC PAIN: pelvic floor physiotherapy before drugs or surgery

groups.title: Symptoms NOT a bother
lines: mild, or moderate–severe that don't affect his life

groups.title: BOTHERSOME (moderate–severe) despite lifestyle
lines: prostate SIZE picks the drug: rectal exam, PSA

groups.title: REFER to urology if
lines: • ANY PSA rise on a 5-alpha reductase inhibitor (5-ARI)

head: h
Alpha blocker
relaxes prostate + bladder neck muscle
watch: current or past use, tamsulosin most · dizziness, orthostatic BP drop

head: h
Alpha blocker ± 5-ARI
the 5-ARI SHRINKS the prostate
tx: finasteride, dutasteride · the combination controls symptoms best
watch: new baseline at 6 months: any rise → refer

head: h
Transurethral resection (TURP)
the GOLD STANDARD surgery
watch: irrigation fluid absorbed → use saline + BIPOLAR cautery
